mapping.auto_approve: the packet manifest reads verified, so the tool call proceeds without asking
mapping.deny: the packet manifest is missing or not verified, so the tool call is refused with a reason
mapping.force_ask: the packet manifest is unreadable or unparsable, so the tool call is held for user confirmation
